metadata.title: Gitea Hosting Ecosystem - Curated Links & Resources
metadata.description: High-impact links for self-hosted Git repositories, Gitea instances, version control tools, and DevOps solutions
metadata.keywords: gitea, self-hosted git, version control, git hosting, devops, ci/cd, open source

links.title: Gitea - Painless Self-Hosted Git Service
links.description: Official Gitea website. A lightweight Git service written in Go with focus on simplicity and minimal resource usage. Perfect for self-hosted Git repositories.

links.title: Gitea GitHub Repository
links.description: Open-source Gitea repository on GitHub. Source code, issues, documentation, and community contributions for self-hosted Git service.

links.title: Gitea Docker Hub - Official Images
links.description: Official Gitea Docker images for containerized deployment. Quick setup for self-hosted Git repositories with Docker.

links.title: Gitea Documentation - Installation Guide
links.description: Complete Gitea installation guide covering binary, Docker, Kubernetes, and package manager installations for different platforms.

links.title: Gitea Kubernetes Helm Chart
links.description: Official Helm chart for deploying Gitea on Kubernetes clusters. Enterprise-grade self-hosted Git service deployment.

links.title: Drone CI - CI/CD for Gitea
links.description: Drone is a popular CI/CD platform that integrates perfectly with Gitea. Lightweight continuous integration for self-hosted Git.

links.title: Gitea Actions - GitHub Actions Compatible
links.description: Gitea Actions brings GitHub Actions compatibility to self-hosted Gitea. Run CI/CD pipelines with familiar workflow syntax.

links.title: Woodpecker CI - Self-Hosted CI/CD
links.description: Woodpecker is a community-driven CI/CD platform for self-hosted environments. Works great with Gitea for automated testing and deployment.

links.title: Git - Official Version Control System
links.description: Official Git website. Learn Git fundamentals, download the tool, and access complete documentation for version control.

links.title: GitHub - Git Hosting Platform
links.description: GitHub - World's leading Git hosting platform. Compare with self-hosted Gitea for understanding cloud vs. self-hosted trade-offs.

links.title: GitLab - Enterprise Git Platform
links.description: GitLab - Full DevOps platform with Git hosting. Alternative to Gitea for teams needing more built-in features.

links.title: Gitolite - Git Access Control
links.description: Gitolite provides fine-grained access control for Git repositories. Often paired with Gitea for advanced permission management.

links.title: Forgejo - Gitea Fork for Community
links.description: Forgejo is a community-driven fork of Gitea. Emphasizes federation and decentralization for Git hosting.

links.title: Gogs - Lightweight Git Service
links.description: Gogs is a lightweight, painless self-hosted Git service. Similar to Gitea but with slightly different philosophy.

links.title: Prometheus - Monitoring for Gitea
links.description: Prometheus monitoring system for tracking Gitea server metrics, health, and performance.

links.title: Let's Encrypt - Free SSL Certificates
links.description: Let's Encrypt provides free SSL/TLS certificates for securing your self-hosted Gitea instance with HTTPS.

links.title: Nginx - Reverse Proxy for Gitea
links.description: Nginx web server commonly used as reverse proxy for Gitea. Excellent for load balancing and SSL termination.

links.title: PostgreSQL - Database for Gitea
links.description: PostgreSQL is the recommended database backend for production Gitea deployments. Reliable, scalable, and feature-rich.
